title: Live scan event (JSON Lines)
description: One line of `scan --stream`, printed the moment the engine learns it: a host answered (`host-up`), a TCP port was found open (`port-open`) or a host finished (`host-done`, responding hosts only).

open.description: host-done only: every TCP port found open

ports_checked.description: host-done only: every requested port was probed

elapsed_ms.description: Milliseconds since the scan was started
